properties.description: Read-only atomic that resolves one exact Cisco Intersight physical server from Device Organization and Server Name or Serial. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations and compute.PhysicalSummaries. The atomic OData-escapes exact inputs, bounds both queries with $inlinecount=allpages and $top=2, requires strict Count/Results completeness, and validates organization and PhysicalSummary discriminators, URL-safe Moids, exact Name-or-Serial matching, Model, PermissionResources, and concrete compute.Blade or compute.RackUnit SourceObjectType. Optional expected Moid and type inputs retain backward-compatible cross-checking for existing callers. It performs no mutation and sends no custom headers.

Validates Device Organization and Server Name or Serial, plus optional backward-compatible expected identity fields, before the runtime target is accessed.
Validates the two required exact selectors and the optional expected-identity pair, rejects URL query delimiters and controls, and doubles apostrophes before any OData request.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

organizationRaw = sys.argv[1]
selectorRaw = sys.argv[2]
expectedMoidRaw = sys.argv[3]
expectedTypeRaw = sys.argv[4]
organizationName = organizationRaw.strip()
serverSelector = selectorRaw.strip()
expectedServerMoid = expectedMoidRaw.strip()
expectedServerObjectType = expectedTypeRaw.strip()
errors = []

for raw, clean, label in (
    (organizationRaw, organizationName, "Device Organization"),
    (selectorRaw, serverSelector, "Server Name or Serial"),
    (expectedMoidRaw, expectedServerMoid, "Expected Server Moid"),
    (expectedTypeRaw, expectedServerObjectType, "Expected Server Object Type")
):
    if raw != clean:
        errors.append(label + " must not contain surrounding whitespace.")

def validate_odata(value, label, maximum):
    if not value or len(value) > maximum or any(ord(ch) < 32 or ch in "&?#%" for ch in value):
        errors.append(label + " must contain 1-" + str(maximum) + " characters and must not contain controls or URL query-delimiter characters.")

validate_odata(organizationName, "Device Organization", 64)
validate_odata(serverSelector, "Server Name or Serial", 128)

expectedPairComplete = bool(expectedServerMoid) and bool(expectedServerObjectType)
if bool(expectedServerMoid) != bool(expectedServerObjectType):
    errors.append("Expected Server Moid and Expected Server Object Type must either both be supplied or both be empty.")
elif expectedPairComplete:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", expectedServerMoid):
        errors.append("Expected Server Moid must be a URL-safe Intersight identifier.")
    if expectedServerObjectType not in ("compute.Blade", "compute.RackUnit"):
        errors.append("Expected Server Object Type must be exactly compute.Blade or compute.RackUnit.")

escapedOrganizationName = organizationName.replace("'", "''")
escapedServerSelector = serverSelector.replace("'", "''")
preparationStatus = "invalid" if errors else "ready"
statusCode = "400" if errors else "200"
statusMessage = "Server identity input validation failed" if errors else "Server identity inputs and OData values were validated."
errorMessage = " ".join(errors)
resultJson = json.dumps({
    "validated": not errors,
    "errors": errors,
    "deviceOrganization": organizationName,
    "serverNameOrSerial": serverSelector,
    "crossCheckRequested": expectedPairComplete,
    "expectedServerMoid": expectedServerMoid or None,
    "expectedServerObjectType": expectedServerObjectType or None
}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = preparationStatus in ("invalid", "ready") and bool(statusCode and statusMessage and resultJson) and (preparationStatus != "ready" or all((escapedOrganizationName, escapedServerSelector)))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

expectedName = sys.argv[2]
organizationStatus = "invalid-response"
statusCode = "502"
statusMessage = "Organization lookup response was invalid"
errorMessage = ""
organizationMoid = ""
resultJson = "{}"

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("Organization response must be a JSON object.")
    count = payload.get("Count")
    values = payload.get("Results")
    if isinstance(count, bool) or not isinstance(count, int) or count < 0:
        raise ValueError("Organization response Count must be a non-negative integer.")
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response is missing a Results array.")
    if count > 2:
        raise ValueError("Organization response Count exceeds the bounded two-result page, so the exact result set is truncated.")
    if count != len(values):
        raise ValueError("Organization response Count does not equal the returned Results length; the bounded page is incomplete.")
    if count == 0:
        organizationStatus = "not-found"
        statusCode = "404"
        statusMessage = "Device organization was not found"
        errorMessage = "No exact organization matched Device Organization."
    elif count > 1:
        organizationStatus = "ambiguous"
        statusCode = "409"
        statusMessage = "Device organization lookup was ambiguous"
        errorMessage = "Multiple organizations matched the exact Device Organization value."
    else:
        item = values[0]
        moid = item.get("Moid") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        problems = []
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            problems.append("Organization result is not an object.")
        else:
            if item.get("Name") != expectedName:
                problems.append("Organization Name does not exactly match Device Organization.")
            if item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ClassId") != "organization.Organization":
                problems.append("Organization discriminators are invalid.")
            if not isinstance(moid, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", moid) is None:
                problems.append("Organization Moid is missing or not URL-safe.")
        if problems:
            organizationStatus = "invalid-response"
            statusCode = "502"
            statusMessage = "Organization lookup response was invalid"
            errorMessage = " ".join(problems)
        else:
            organizationStatus = "exact"
            statusCode = "200"
            statusMessage = "Device organization resolved exactly"
            errorMessage = ""
            organizationMoid = moid
    resultJson = json.dumps({
        "status": organizationStatus,
        "message": errorMessage or statusMessage,
        "organization": {
            "Name": expectedName,
            "Moid": organizationMoid or None,
            "ObjectType": "organization.Organization"
        },
        "count": count
    }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    organizationStatus = "invalid-response"
    statusCode = "502"
    statusMessage = "Organization lookup response was invalid"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"status": organizationStatus, "error": errorMessage, "organization": {"Name": expectedName, "Moid": None, "ObjectType": "organization.Organization"}}, separators=(",", ":"))

helperReady = organizationStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid-response", "exact") and bool(statusCode and statusMessage and resultJson) and (organizationStatus != "exact" or bool(organizationMoid))
